    Profile

    Almira is a girl from the Saga Region who has already made a name for herself as a young hunter. She skillfully hunts her prey with her own handmade weaponry. Her sidekick is a large sized falcon, as she's also highly gifted as a falconer. She has various other falcon companions, and she spends her days hunting with them.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Aug 1
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Meat
    Hobbies: Falconry
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 喜多村英梨
